name: Risk-on macro regime + ADX trend — LLM risk-appetite-gated trend (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why the risk-appetite index leads): risk_on_off is an LLM-standardized [-1,+1] read on the shared macro/geopolitical risk regime, minted at evidence-availability time. Crypto is a high-beta risk asset, so a risk-ON macro backdrop is the tailwind that lets a trend extend, while a risk-OFF backdrop chops trends up. The regime tag conditions cross-asset risk premia BEFORE any single asset's price fully reflects it, giving a lead. We gate an ADX-confirmed trend on risk_on_off above a positive floor (only ride trends WITH the macro wind), and exit when the regime flips risk-off. The LLM only proposes the number against a fixed rubric; it is never on the money path. DISCONFIRMER 1: if ADX-trend alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the regime gate adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: risk_on_off could lag headlines (coincident, not leading) — if entering on a risk-off reading does equally well, it is not a directional macro lead. tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: risk_on_off (LLM macro risk-appetite index) is positive while ADX confirms a trend.
